question: Should OpenClaw accept `openclaw.claw.v1`, `openclaw.clawFeed.v1`, `openclaw.clawPlan.v1`, `openclaw.clawApplyPlan.v1`, and the `openclaw claws inspect/apply --dry-run` plus feed inspect/apply commands as the first core Claws validation lifecycle while the RFC remains open?
rationale: The patch is read-only and reviewable, but the schema and CLI names are compatibility-sensitive product contracts that automation cannot approve safely.

options.title: Approve The Initial Contract
options.body: Maintainers explicitly accept the schema versions, entry/feed semantics, dry-run apply JSON, and command names before normal merge gates proceed.

options.title: Hold For RFC Acceptance
options.body: Keep this PR draft or paused until the linked RFC records the accepted or narrowed direction.

options.title: Revise Before Merge
options.body: Change contract names, schema shapes, or command semantics in this PR before they become a public compatibility baseline.

recommendation.title: Approve The Initial Contract
recommendation.body: Maintainers explicitly accept the schema versions, entry/feed semantics, dry-run apply JSON, and command names before normal merge gates proceed.
